# PREMIUM WELLNESS, MEDICAL, SPA EQUIPMENT & TECHNOLOGIES

**Gharieni** is a leading international manufacturer of **premium wellness equipment, **including**
luxury spa tables**, **massage beds,** **medical chairs**, and **professional beauty beds.** Since
1990, the legacy brand has pioneered development of the most advanced **treatment tables** and**
luxury spa-furniture** available on the on the market today.

Gharieni’s **German-engineered spa equipment** unites exceptional craftsmanship with modern,
ergonomic** design**, and next generation **wellness technology. **From **vibroacoustic therapy**,
to **heated massage tables**, and **multifunctional spa furniture**, every piece is designed to meet
the evolving needs of **luxury wellness professionals, **whilst delivering unmatched comfort and
transformative wellness benefits.

**Forbes Travel Guide Official Partner**

Since 2019, the Gharieni Group has been the exclusive ‘Official Spa & Wellness Technologies and
Equipment Brand’ for the Forbes Travel Guide, the global authority on luxury travel. This
prestigious partnership validates our position as the premier choice for **world-class spa equipment
**in the most discerning **luxury hotels and destination spas **worldwide.

# PREMIUM WELLNESS, MEDICAL, SPA EQUIPMENT & TECHNOLOGIES

**Gharieni** is a leading international manufacturer of **premium wellness equipment, **including**
luxury spa tables**, **massage beds,** **medical chairs**, and **professional beauty beds.** Since
1990, the legacy brand has pioneered development of the most advanced **treatment tables** and**
luxury spa-furniture** available on the on the market today.

Gharieni’s **German-engineered spa equipment** unites exceptional craftsmanship with modern,
ergonomic** design**, and next generation **wellness technology. **From **vibroacoustic therapy**,
to **heated massage tables**, and **multifunctional spa furniture**, every piece is designed to meet
the evolving needs of **luxury wellness professionals, **whilst delivering unmatched comfort and
transformative wellness benefits.

**Forbes Travel Guide Official Partner**

Since 2019, the Gharieni Group has been the exclusive ‘Official Spa & Wellness Technologies and
Equipment Brand’ for the Forbes Travel Guide, the global authority on luxury travel. This
prestigious partnership validates our position as the premier choice for **world-class spa equipment
**in the most discerning **luxury hotels and destination spas **worldwide.

## Wellness, delivered™

Soothe is a marketplace that connects individuals and businesses with highly-rated independent
professionals offering massage, skincare, hair, and beauty services.

[ Book Now ][43]

## In-Home Services

Enjoy the ease of bringing wellness professionals right to your door! With the Soothe app, you can
easily book services with your preferred provider and schedule them at a time and place that works
best for you.

Get even more value by joining SoothePass®, our monthly membership, and make wellness a consistent
part of your healthy lifestyle, all while saving on every service.

[ Learn More ][44]
[Soothe Client App][Soothe Client App]

## Spa & Hospitality Solutions

Ensure guests always receive exceptional service while maximizing revenue. Simply post available
shifts to pre-approved, independent, licensed wellness professionals in the marketplace and
seamlessly expand during peak times without hiring additional staff.

Don’t have a spa? No problem! Access a network of top-rated licensed massage therapists and wellness
professionals to provide on-demand services that guests and residents will love.

[ Learn More ][45]

## Employee Wellness Solutions

Attract and retain top talent by providing wellness programs that reflect your company’s culture and
values. Designed to support both in-office and remote employees, Soothe’s nationwide network
guarantees access to reliable, high-quality wellness services, no matter where your team is located.

[ Learn More ][46]
[Office Chair Massage][Office Chair Massage]

## Soothe Provider Community

Soothe enables you to grow your business on your terms — set your availability and service areas,
manage your appointments and earning potential, and much more — all via the Soothe Pro app.

[ Learn More ][47]

## Refer a friend to Soothe, get $50*

Know someone who would love Soothe? Share the love.

They’ll get $50 off by using your code at checkout, and when they complete their first appointment,
you get $50. This is one of our best deals yet!

[ Invite Friends ][48]

****Referral program access and sharing are available exclusively through the Soothe app.***

Enjoy the ease of bringing wellness professionals right to your door! With the Soothe app, you can
easily book services with your preferred provider and schedule them at a time and place that works
best for you.

Get even more value by joining SoothePass®, our monthly membership, and make wellness a consistent
part of your healthy lifestyle, all while saving on every service.

## Spa & Hospitality Solutions

Ensure guests always receive exceptional service while maximizing revenue. Simply post available
shifts to pre-approved, independent, licensed wellness professionals in the marketplace and
seamlessly expand during peak times without hiring additional staff.

Don’t have a spa? No problem! Access a network of top-rated licensed massage therapists and wellness
professionals to provide on-demand services that guests and residents will love.

values. Designed to support both in-office and remote employees, Soothe’s nationwide network
guarantees access to reliable, high-quality wellness services, no matter where your team is located.

manage your appointments and earning potential, and much more — all via the Soothe Pro app.

Our portfolio of experience has included working with day spas, hotels, resorts and health retreats,

to pre-opening projects and existing businesses.

### **the team**

We are a synergistic team of industry experts, having come together through a shared passion for spa
retreats and eco-luxe lifestyles. We are well versed in the yin and yang of achieving a commercial
outcome, whilst still delivering on the perfect guest experience. To bring your dream and vision to
life is our calling.

[LEARN MORE][23]

### **KIND WORDS **

Testimonials
[
][24]

*"Sonja is a true Spa professional in every sense of the word. She assisted by leading the creation
and launch of Eos by SkyCity’s Day Spa, a part of SkyCity’s $330million Expansion, which opened in

indulgent and distinctive spa product, but also one that combines the Eos brand pillars."*

**JODI BROWN

[
][25]

*“Sonja Sorich is a dedicated force in the luxury spa market and worldwide wellness industry. Her
passion for excellence and vast experience combines a unique ability to manage both boutique
start-ups and established corporate destination spa retreats. This makes her a global leader in the
flourishing arena of wellness tourism.”*

____

**SAMANTHA GOWING
AUSTRALIA’S LEADING SPA CHEF**

[
][26]

*"Sonja is a proven industry leader in the arena of luxury spas, wellness and health retreats. She
holds a commitment to personal growth, natural skincare, ecology and sustainability. With wellness
emerging as a growing trend, it’s imperative that we stay true to what it actually means. Sonja is
one person who walks her talk and can confidently fly the flag as a wellness ambassador."*

_____

**MARK WUTTKE

### [Sauna, Steam Bath and Jacuzzi System][53]

[Read more][54]

Established in 2003, not only do we pride ourselves on distributing quality and reasonably priced
salon & home care products in the beauty industry, we are also known for our great customer service
standards. To date, we have supplied over 300 beauty salons, including home based ones in Singapore
and Johor, Malaysia. All our skin care product brands from France, USA, Switzerland and Japan focus
on using only natural minerals and botanical extracts as key ingredients, unveiling the natural
active ingredients that provide great aesthetic effects to enhance the natural beauty of both women
and men. We offer more than 200 types of products, including cleansers, toners, soft masks,
ampoules, anti-ageing & whitening products and massage cream, as well as disposable items such as
face masks and bed sheets etc for beauty salons to choose from. 

In the recent few years, we have expanded our services to include sale & repair of
manufacturing of OEM skin care products, beauty equipment, supply, installation, maintenance and
repair of sauna system, steam bath system and jacuzzi system. Our dedication and professionalism in
this area has won the hearts of many beauty salons and even residences such as condominium councils
and home owners. As our company continue to grow and bring in newer & better products as well as
service to meet the market’s changing needs, we urge you to give our products and services a try,
simply because we give you only the best.

### [Sauna, Steam Bath and Jacuzzi System][53]

[Read more][54]

Established in 2003, not only do we pride ourselves on distributing quality and reasonably priced
salon & home care products in the beauty industry, we are also known for our great customer service
standards. To date, we have supplied over 300 beauty salons, including home based ones in Singapore
and Johor, Malaysia. All our skin care product brands from France, USA, Switzerland and Japan focus
on using only natural minerals and botanical extracts as key ingredients, unveiling the natural
active ingredients that provide great aesthetic effects to enhance the natural beauty of both women
and men. We offer more than 200 types of products, including cleansers, toners, soft masks,
ampoules, anti-ageing & whitening products and massage cream, as well as disposable items such as
face masks and bed sheets etc for beauty salons to choose from. 

In the recent few years, we have expanded our services to include sale & repair of
manufacturing of OEM skin care products, beauty equipment, supply, installation, maintenance and
repair of sauna system, steam bath system and jacuzzi system. Our dedication and professionalism in
this area has won the hearts of many beauty salons and even residences such as condominium councils
and home owners. As our company continue to grow and bring in newer & better products as well as
service to meet the market’s changing needs, we urge you to give our products and services a try,
simply because we give you only the best.

## At adona spaLodge

Since 2013, adona Spa Lodge in Addis Ababa has been a place where care becomes an experience. The
name adona, meaning "My Mother," embodies the warmth, protection, and devotion of a mother's
love—guiding every touch, every ritual, and every moment we create. Here, wellness is not just a
service; it is a feeling, a choice, and a lifestyle.

We invite our guests to move beyond reactive care, embracing practices that nourish the body, calm
the mind, and awaken vitality. Every visit is an invitation to reclaim balance, embrace health, and
carry the serenity of the spa into everyday life.

At adona spaLodge, we cultivate a world of splendid beauty and a relaxation lifestyle, where each
moment lingers, each experience restores, and every guest leaves renewed.

Прямой доступ к берегу, рыбалка и водные развлечения

## What APPSeCONNECT Does

## TOP 5 FAQ’s

##### 1. How much do your hot tubs and All-Weather pools cost?

We pride ourselves on offering incomparable customization for your spa, allowing you to build your
ideal relaxation environment! Because of this versatility, we are unable to pinpoint a standard
price for all of our models. Please visit your local dealer for specific pricing information.

##### 2. I don’t have a lot of room in my backyard, do you have a spa that will fit my space?

Yes! We offer a range of capacities and sizes in our hot tub lineup. From 1-2 person models, all the
way up to 8+ occupant spas, we have something for everyone.

##### 3. Is the water in an Arctic Spa difficult to maintain?

With Arctic Spas’ exclusive water maintenance tool, Spa Boy®, owning a hot tub has never been
simpler! Easily maintain your ideal water conditions with Spa Boy’s automated balancing
capabilities, transforming your hot tub care routine from 30 minutes to 30 seconds.

##### 4. Will my power bill surge in colder months?

Not only does an Arctic Spa consume less energy than other hot tub models, we also utilize
innovative technology in our FreeHeat™ design to prevent your bills from shooting up as the
temperature outside drops.

##### 5. Can I add features to my spa after I buy it?

Nearly all of our spas are completely customizable before, or after purchase. Visit your local
dealer to see which features can elevate your spa experience!

## TOP 5 FAQ’s

##### 1. How much do your hot tubs and All-Weather pools cost?

We pride ourselves on offering incomparable customization for your spa, allowing you to build your
ideal relaxation environment! Because of this versatility, we are unable to pinpoint a standard
price for all of our models. Please visit your local dealer for specific pricing information.

##### 2. I don’t have a lot of room in my backyard, do you have a spa that will fit my space?

Yes! We offer a range of capacities and sizes in our hot tub lineup. From 1-2 person models, all the
way up to 8+ occupant spas, we have something for everyone.

##### 3. Is the water in an Arctic Spa difficult to maintain?

With Arctic Spas’ exclusive water maintenance tool, Spa Boy®, owning a hot tub has never been
simpler! Easily maintain your ideal water conditions with Spa Boy’s automated balancing
capabilities, transforming your hot tub care routine from 30 minutes to 30 seconds.

##### 4. Will my power bill surge in colder months?

Not only does an Arctic Spa consume less energy than other hot tub models, we also utilize
innovative technology in our FreeHeat™ design to prevent your bills from shooting up as the
temperature outside drops.

##### 5. Can I add features to my spa after I buy it?

Nearly all of our spas are completely customizable before, or after purchase. Visit your local
dealer to see which features can elevate your spa experience!

### SOLUCIONES SOSTENIBLES PARA PISCINAS

][295]

La conciencia medioambiental es cada vez más importante, AstralPool ofrece una gama de productos
innovadores que priorizan la eficiencia y la sostenibilidad.

 

¡Abraza la sostenibilidad con los 5 productos clave de AstralPool!

 

Nuestros cinco productos sostenibles principales están diseñados para mejorar tu experiencia en la
piscina al tiempo que minimizan el impacto en el planeta.

[ Leer más ][296]
Soluciones
[

### BIENESTAR Y SALUD

][297]

Según la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS): "La salud es una estado completo de bienestar
físico, mental y social, y no solamente la ausencia de afecciones o enfermedades".

 

En Astralpool disponemos de todo tipo de soluciones para el mantenimiento de la salud física y
mental de nuestros clientes.

[ Leer más ][298]
Soluciones
[

### UNA PISCINA SEGURA

][299]

En estos tiempos de incertidumbre, en los que el miedo al Covid19 está tan presente, vamos a
analizar la situación de las piscinas, sus riesgos potenciales y el tratamiento que debe recibir el
agua para asegurar que la piscina sea un lugar seguro.

[ Leer más ][300]
Soluciones
[

### CLIMATIZACIÓN

][301]

Climatizar la piscina es sinónimo de alargar la temporada de baño y mejorar el confort simplemente
aumentando unos grados el agua de su piscina.

[ Leer más ][302]

[

### TRATAMIENTO DEL AGUA

][303]

Los sistemas de electrólisis salina añaden un nuevo concepto en el tratamiento del agua de la
piscina, ya que aumentan la calidad del agua, evitan la utilización de productos químicos y
facilitan los trabajos de mantenimiento.

[ Leer más ][304]

### SOLUCIONES SOSTENIBLES PARA PISCINAS

][295]

La conciencia medioambiental es cada vez más importante, AstralPool ofrece una gama de productos
innovadores que priorizan la eficiencia y la sostenibilidad.

 

¡Abraza la sostenibilidad con los 5 productos clave de AstralPool!

 

Nuestros cinco productos sostenibles principales están diseñados para mejorar tu experiencia en la
piscina al tiempo que minimizan el impacto en el planeta.

### BIENESTAR Y SALUD

][297]

Según la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS): "La salud es una estado completo de bienestar
físico, mental y social, y no solamente la ausencia de afecciones o enfermedades".

 

En Astralpool disponemos de todo tipo de soluciones para el mantenimiento de la salud física y
mental de nuestros clientes.

][299]

En estos tiempos de incertidumbre, en los que el miedo al Covid19 está tan presente, vamos a
analizar la situación de las piscinas, sus riesgos potenciales y el tratamiento que debe recibir el
agua para asegurar que la piscina sea un lugar seguro.

facilitan los trabajos de mantenimiento.

## Discover our destinations

[BT Mayakoba][BT Mayakoba]


### Riviera Maya, Mexico

Nestled within a private gated community linked by canal waterways, Banyan Tree Mayakoba offers
timeless design in harmony with an arcadia of surrounding untouched nature.

[Explore More][20]
[MRR Singapore][MRR Singapore]


### Singapore

Escape the urban jungle and awaken in the rainforest. Nestled within Mandai Wildlife Reserve, this
sanctuary in a city offers conscious stays amidst the trees.

[Explore More][21]
[BT SAMUI][BT SAMUI]


### Samui, Thailand

Retreat to the secluded haven of Banyan Tree Samui, where every villa has its own private pool,
perfect for maximizing relaxation and uplifting the senses.

[Explore More][22]
[Krabi][Krabi]


### Krabi, Thailand

Find peace and comfort in our idyllic beachfront resort of Banyan Tree Krabi, where every suite or
villa offers mesmerizing views of the Andaman sea.

[Explore More][23]
[BT Vabbinfaru][BT Vabbinfaru]


### North Malé Atoll, Maldives

Banyan Tree Vabbinfaru brings Maldivian culture to life through sensory journeys, from signature
rituals to locally inspired culinary experiences crafted with fresh, local ingredients.

[Explore More][24]
[BT Lang Co ][BT Lang Co ]


### Lăng Cô, Vietnam

Banyan Tree Lăng Cô is a beachside paradise of luxurious all-pool villas, nestled between the East
Sea and the Truong Son mountain range.

[Explore More][25]
[BT PHUKET][BT PHUKET]


### Phuket, Thailand

Banyan Tree Phuket offers a uniquely luxurious pool villa resort experience as you explore local
culture, restore inner peace, and progress your personal wellness journey.

[Explore More][26]
[BT Bintan][BT Bintan]


### Bintan, Indonesia

Set on stilts by the hillside, Banyan Tree Bintan offers a sense of serenity surrounded by ancient
rainforests and views of the South China Sea.

[Explore More][27]
[BT KYOTO][BT KYOTO]


### Kyoto, Japan

Perched in Kyoto's Gion and Higashiyama district, Banyan Tree Kyoto offers 52 luxurious rooms with
stunning city views, a Noh stage, and natural hot springs.

[Explore More][28]
[BT Shanghai Night View][BT Shanghai Night View]


### Shanghai, China

In the sprawling metropolis of Shanghai is one of the world's largest cities, with a vibrant urban
life, impressive skyline and rich culture. Right in the middle of all this, on the bank of the
Huangpu River, lies Banyan Tree Shanghai On The Bund, an urban retreat in the city's most scenic
location

[Explore More][29]
[BT Bangkok][BT Bangkok]


### Bangkok, Thailand

Banyan Tree Bangkok is the only 5-star all-suite hotel in the metropolitan, multicultural city of
Bangkok, offering a high-rise luxurious oasis amidst bustling cityscapes, exotic street food, and
endless shopping.

[Explore More][30]
[BT Cabo Marques][BT Cabo Marques]


### Cabo Marqués, Mexico

Be entranced by Acapulco with its stunning sunsets, famous cliffs and captivating ocean views, at
our AAA Five Diamond Award resort, Banyan Tree Cabo Marqués.

[Explore More][31]
[BT Veya][BT Veya]


### Baja California, México

Discover the abundance of Baja California, Mexico's wine country in Banyan Tree Veya Valle de
Guadalupe, and find tranquility in a bespoke vineyard sanctuary.

[Explore More][32]

## Rewild your soul in the untamed nature of Ruaha

#### OPENING AUGUST 2026


Ubuyu, a Banyan Tree Escape, is an invitation to rewild your soul. An intimate safari retreat set in
the untouched nature of Ruaha National Park. Here, expansive, artisan-crafted villas overlook the
Great Ruaha River. Harmoniously woven into the open savannah, where animals roam freely in their
natural habitat.

mind.

# WELCOME TO BAROS

The Maldives Icon

Turquoise waters lap at white-sand shores. Towering palms rustle overhead. Welcome to Baros, a
natural paradise with a lush island canopy, just 25 minutes by speedboat from the Maldives’
international airport. We’ve been welcoming guests since 1973, and have spent decades honing our
services and cultivating our environment, crafting what we believe is a legendary resort. Today,
we’re one of the most loved luxury Maldives resorts properties, and we’re excited to show you what
makes us so special.

Romantic Interludes

Sandbank Dining at Baros Maldives][Romantic Sandbank Dining at Baros Maldives]

ceremony or simply wish to embrace the island’s romantic surroundings, this is the perfect place to
spend quality time with your significant other.
[Arrival-Jetty with Yacht at Baros Maldives][Arrival-Jetty with Yacht at Baros Maldives]

touchdown at Velana International Airport near the capital city island of Male’.
[Underwater Activities at Baros Maldives][Underwater Activities at Baros Maldives] [Underwater
Discovery at Baros Maldives][Underwater Discovery at Baros Maldives]
Personalised, à la carte diving. There are 30 dive sites and one ancient shipwreck within 50 minutes

revolutionary Fluo night diving experience.

reefs of the Maldives.

Each villa at Baros has a dedicated Villa Host, there to ensure the personal satisfaction of every

at our fine dining hallmark, Lighthouse Restaurant, a themed evening at one of our beachside
eateries or an exclusive dining experience on a remote sandbank, an unusual Piano Deck in the lagoon
or the beach.

welcoming ambience. A private pool in the garden courtyard is framed by tropical flowers, while a
front deck leads to your own stretch of Baros beach. Butler service 24 hours a day ensures you have
everything you need, when you need it.

private pool and deck. Your stay is enhanced with personalised butler service, an exclusive boat
cruise and a private dinner experience.

privacy and calm with classic design, for guests to enjoy the freedom of space as well as the
inspiration of tropical tranquillity and a chance to relax in solitude.

reef are just metres away.

# WELCOME TO BAROS

The Maldives Icon

Turquoise waters lap at white-sand shores. Towering palms rustle overhead. Welcome to Baros, a
natural paradise with a lush island canopy, just 25 minutes by speedboat from the Maldives’
international airport. We’ve been welcoming guests since 1973, and have spent decades honing our
services and cultivating our environment, crafting what we believe is a legendary resort. Today,
we’re one of the most loved luxury Maldives resorts properties, and we’re excited to show you what
makes us so special.

Romantic Interludes
Location
Diving By Design
Memorable Experiences
The Beautiful House Reef
Authenticity
Dedicated Butler
Gourmet Dining
[Romantic Beach Dining at Baros Maldives][Romantic Beach Dining at Baros Maldives] [Romantic
Sandbank Dining at Baros Maldives][Romantic Sandbank Dining at Baros Maldives]
Baros Maldives is designed for couples. Whether you plan to visit for your honeymoon, vow renewal
ceremony or simply wish to embrace the island’s romantic surroundings, this is the perfect place to
spend quality time with your significant other.
[Arrival-Jetty with Yacht at Baros Maldives][Arrival-Jetty with Yacht at Baros Maldives]
[Arrival-Jetty at Baros Luxury Resort Maldives][Arrival-Jetty at Baros Luxury Resort Maldives]
Faraway but near enough. Tranquillity and relaxation are a quick 25-minute speedboat trip from
touchdown at Velana International Airport near the capital city island of Male’.
[Underwater Activities at Baros Maldives][Underwater Activities at Baros Maldives] [Underwater
Discovery at Baros Maldives][Underwater Discovery at Baros Maldives]
Personalised, à la carte diving. There are 30 dive sites and one ancient shipwreck within 50 minutes
speedboat trip of Baros, some of which are ranked among the top ten dive sites in the Maldives. Also
available at our Eco Dive Centre (one of the first of its kind in the Maldives), is the
revolutionary Fluo night diving experience.
[Unique Overwater Dining Experience in Maldives][Unique Overwater Dining Experience in Maldives]
[Romantic Celebrations on Sea Deck at Baros Maldives][Romantic Celebrations on Sea Deck at Baros
Maldives]
The experiences offered at Baros are those you remember for a lifetime. From sunset and sunrise
yogas sessions and private dining experiences to memorable dhoni cruises along the turquoise waters
of the lagoon and starlit cinema offerings — a trip to Baros is bound to live on in your mind long
after the flight home.
[Exploring the Sea Life in Maldives][Exploring the Sea Life in Maldives] [Snorkelling in House of
Reef at Baros Resort Maldives][Snorkelling in House of Reef at Baros Resort Maldives]
Surrounding the island and a short swim from the shore, the vibrant house reef is bright with
colours, fish, turtles, rays and living coral. It is believed to be one of the healthiest and best
reefs of the Maldives.
[Man Climbing a Coconut Tree at Baros Maldives][Man Climbing a Coconut Tree at Baros Maldives] [Man
Climbing a Coconut Tree in Maldives][Man Climbing a Coconut Tree in Maldives]
A rich heritage – one of the first resorts in the Maldives, setting the benchmark for luxury - with
genuine, heartfelt Maldivian hospitality.
[Guest walking on the Beach in Maldives][Guest walking on the Beach in Maldives] [Private Beach view
at Baros Luxury Resort][Private Beach view at Baros Luxury Resort]
Each villa at Baros has a dedicated Villa Host, there to ensure the personal satisfaction of every
guest.
[Best Restaurants in Baros Luxury Resort Maldives][Best Restaurants in Baros Luxury Resort Maldives]
[View of Lighthouse Restaurant over the lagoon during Dusk][View of Lighthouse Restaurant over the
lagoon during Dusk]
Our three restaurants offer exquisite cuisine to suit every palate. Choose from a culinary adventure
at our fine dining hallmark, Lighthouse Restaurant, a themed evening at one of our beachside
eateries or an exclusive dining experience on a remote sandbank, an unusual Piano Deck in the lagoon
or the beach.

## firmwear

biotech firm + lift serum powered by biomimetic mini-protein

Video Transcription
Your skin doesn’t lose firmness overnight. It loses structure over time, layer by layer. Support
weakens. Lines settle. That’s where targeted science comes in. Meet Bioelements Firmwear: A next-gen
firm and lift serum built on biotech. The Firmwear triple pathway starts with a biomimetic
mini-protein. Designed to integrate with the skin’s natural scaffolding, the 3D folded
mini-structure strengthens support and softens expression lines. Paired with our retinol-alt
complex: A renewal duo of a biomimetic retinopeptide and bakuchiol. Together, they enhance
elasticity and refine tone, so texture is visibly smoother. Mimicking retinol’s proven pathways
without the irritation. And for recovery: Cica exosomes. Bioengineered nano-messengers that calm,
repair, and accelerate skin renewal, so skin appears firmer. Clinically tested. Science-backed. And
proven to lift, firm, smooth, and sculpt your skin’s appearance. Based on a 42-day consumer

# Find Your Blissful Escape

## A European-Style Spa & Wellness Retreat

Voted one of the "Top 10 Best Spas in the World" by the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards,
Cal-a-Vie Health Spa offers an intimate and gorgeous self-care hideaway designed for the mind, body,
and spirit. Nestled between vast fields of grapevines with stunning views, discover an elegantly
life-changing wellness retreat. This is Cal-a-Vie Health Spa.

Devoted to Your Wellbeing
[Array]

## Endless Amenities & Activities

Cal-a-Vie Health Spa is a destination like none other. Explore meditation techniques, culinary
demonstrations, spa treatments, fitness classes, beauty services, and much more.

[a woman posing in front of a wall with art]

## Tailor-Made for Every Guest

From pickleball games and nutritious cooking classes to candlelit yoga and hikes through nature, our
team creates customized schedules for each guest to experience.

[Array]

## Refined French Elegance in California

Combining European spa philosophies with the Californian concepts of fitness, health, and nutrition,
Cal-a-Vie Health Spa creates a new standard of beauty and elegance.

# An ode to beauty in paphos

An ode to beauty where bliss is manifested, Cali Resort & Spa is a A 5* melody of elegance has
opened its doors!

Hold your breath for the most tranquil pause from daily life, enhanced by the sweet euphony of the
natural world beside Paphos’ famous Blue-Flag Coral Bay.

This is where vacations unfold in sync with a rugged coastal landscape. A soul-soothing world where
endless experiences and personalised services await – a place away from it all where artful touches
and refined elegance dance to the same harmonious beat, inviting you to totally relax and unwind.

[hotel]

## A 5* melody of elegance has opened its doors!

Enter a new world of poetic ambiance where every holiday is transformed into a coastal lullaby that
touches the soul with a soothing caress.

Dedicated to refined style, endless serenity, and uninterrupted tranquility, the latest member of
Louis Hotels’ elegant collection offers guests over the age of 16 the ultimate retreat from the
demands of daily life.

Open spaces and earthy tones set the stage for the perfect escape where art and opulence are
entwined in ethereal beauty.

A total of 201 rooms invite you to unwind in a sonata of warmth and comfort, while in the resort’s
two restaurants, every dining experience is a powerful duet of taste and presentation. An ode to the
finest flavours and prime ingredients, evoking a symphony of pure delight. Taste buds are further
tantalised with carefully crafted drinks that flow throughout the day and evening, whether you dream
of al fresco poolside cocktails or a delectable indoor nightcap.

Within the resort’s expansive grounds, diverse amenities set the stage for ultimate relaxation,
including a serene indoor pool and a 47-metre freshwater outdoor pool. In the soothing spa, wellness
is orchestrated to resonate with your individual needs and desires.

[hotel]

## In tune with nature’s cadence

Ideal for blissful seclusion, Cali Resort & Spa offers a haven of tranquility and distinctive charm,
harmoniously set amidst a panoramic landscape with 360-degree views.

A true getaway for adults seeking relaxation and rejuvenation, the immersive experience is enhanced
by the captivating charm of this poetic destination. Overlooking Coral Bay, the most picturesque
beach in Cyprus, the resort represents the pinnacle of Louis Hotels' elegance. Prepare to be
enchanted by the unparalleled beauty of Paphos as you luxuriate in the epito¬me of comfort.

This is your time to let go, caressed by the whisper of the waves, enveloped in nature’s melody,
coloured by the golden glow of the most picturesque sunsets on the island.

[hotel]

## Why Book Direct?

* Complimentary 15-minute massage per person (for minimum stays of 4 nights)
* Fruits & wine in your room on arrival
* A thoughtful farewell gift before departure
* Daily turndown service for added comfort
* One complimentary dinner at FIKI Japanese Restaurant per week (for Half Board & All-Inclusive
  guests)

# An ode to beauty in paphos

An ode to beauty where bliss is manifested, Cali Resort & Spa is a A 5* melody of elegance has
opened its doors!

Hold your breath for the most tranquil pause from daily life, enhanced by the sweet euphony of the
natural world beside Paphos’ famous Blue-Flag Coral Bay.

This is where vacations unfold in sync with a rugged coastal landscape. A soul-soothing world where
endless experiences and personalised services await – a place away from it all where artful touches
and refined elegance dance to the same harmonious beat, inviting you to totally relax and unwind.

[hotel]

## A 5* melody of elegance has opened its doors!

Enter a new world of poetic ambiance where every holiday is transformed into a coastal lullaby that
touches the soul with a soothing caress.

Dedicated to refined style, endless serenity, and uninterrupted tranquility, the latest member of
Louis Hotels’ elegant collection offers guests over the age of 16 the ultimate retreat from the
demands of daily life.

Open spaces and earthy tones set the stage for the perfect escape where art and opulence are
entwined in ethereal beauty.

A total of 201 rooms invite you to unwind in a sonata of warmth and comfort, while in the resort’s
two restaurants, every dining experience is a powerful duet of taste and presentation. An ode to the
finest flavours and prime ingredients, evoking a symphony of pure delight. Taste buds are further
tantalised with carefully crafted drinks that flow throughout the day and evening, whether you dream
of al fresco poolside cocktails or a delectable indoor nightcap.

Within the resort’s expansive grounds, diverse amenities set the stage for ultimate relaxation,
including a serene indoor pool and a 47-metre freshwater outdoor pool. In the soothing spa, wellness
is orchestrated to resonate with your individual needs and desires.

[hotel]

## In tune with nature’s cadence

Ideal for blissful seclusion, Cali Resort & Spa offers a haven of tranquility and distinctive charm,
harmoniously set amidst a panoramic landscape with 360-degree views.

A true getaway for adults seeking relaxation and rejuvenation, the immersive experience is enhanced
by the captivating charm of this poetic destination. Overlooking Coral Bay, the most picturesque
beach in Cyprus, the resort represents the pinnacle of Louis Hotels' elegance. Prepare to be
enchanted by the unparalleled beauty of Paphos as you luxuriate in the epito¬me of comfort.

This is your time to let go, caressed by the whisper of the waves, enveloped in nature’s melody,
coloured by the golden glow of the most picturesque sunsets on the island.

[hotel]

  Revitalization of mind, body, and spirit should be as healthy as it is satisfying.

  Nature is woven into the built environment to support the mind, body, and soul.

  The best moments become the ones we return to for years.
* ### Bespoke Sustainability
  
  The most sustainable products are tailored to everyday lifestyles.

  Food should be as good for your soul as it is for your body.

### [Europe][57]

Long evenings bleeding into warm nights made for zipping around on a red Vespa. Gelato melting
faster than you can eat it. Aperitifs and sardines at a delightfully chaotic taverna. Nothing spells

## Mediterranean character meets coastal calm

# Discover our five-star resort in Pissouri Bay, Cyprus

Set on the secluded shores of Pissouri Bay, Columbia Beach Resort blends thoughtful touches, elegant
spaces and the beauty of the coastline to create a stay that stays with you.

## Suites

Stay with us

Our suites offer a comfortable base for days beside the bay. Whether you're here to unwind or
explore, it’s a stay that lets the setting speak for itself.

[ Explore our suites ][45]

Eat & drink

## A taste of the island

Seasonal ingredients and Mediterranean flavours guide our kitchens, from relaxed Mediterranean
plates to refined and gourmet dining. Add Half Board Terms or Full board terms to your booking for a
simple way to enjoy food by the coast.
[ Explore our restaurants ][46]

## Space to restore

designed to help you settle into a slower rhythm.

## Mediterranean character meets coastal calm

# Discover our five-star resort in Pissouri Bay, Cyprus

Set on the secluded shores of Pissouri Bay, Columbia Beach Resort blends thoughtful touches, elegant
spaces and the beauty of the coastline to create a stay that stays with you.

## Suites

Stay with us

Our suites offer a comfortable base for days beside the bay. Whether you're here to unwind or
explore, it’s a stay that lets the setting speak for itself.

[ Explore our suites ][45]

Eat & drink

## A taste of the island

Seasonal ingredients and Mediterranean flavours guide our kitchens, from relaxed Mediterranean
plates to refined and gourmet dining. Add Half Board Terms or Full board terms to your booking for a
simple way to enjoy food by the coast.
[ Explore our restaurants ][46]

Spa & wellness

## Space to restore

Quiet rooms, warm water and renewing treatments create a calming rhythm at Hébe Spa. Each therapy is
designed to help you settle into a slower rhythm.
[ Explore our spa ][47]

[ ; ][27]

## **Beijing Daxing Airport is Finally Open**

**Beijing Daxing International Airport (PKX)**, also known as Beijing New Airport, is the airport
featuring the second largest single-building terminal in the world. It opened its doors on September
26, 2019, and is a multi-awarded airport. It is also the second international airport in Beijing.
Indeed, Beijing Daxing Airport and Beijing Capital International Airport are the two international
aviation hubs of the Chinese capital, as the adjacent Beijing Nanyuan Airport closed once the new
airport began its operation.

The airport’s design is pioneering. Designed by the renowned architect Zaha Hadid, the terminal is
spread over 700,000m² (7,500,000 sq ft) and is considered a state of art. Moreover, PKX Airport
boasts 4 runways (as well as one military runway) and an impressive number of 82 boarding gates. On
the other hand, its location in Daxing District (the southern suburbs of Beijing) is ideal for
serving the Chinese capital and the neighboring areas of Hebei and Tianjin. The new mega-airport hub
served more than 39.4 million passengers in 2023 and is expected to reach an outstanding 100 million
passenger flow in the future. 

**Daxing Airport** is located at the frontier between Beijing and Langfang, Hebei Province, and
serves the needs of Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei areas. Its location was selected after thorough
analysis. It is actually located between Yufa Town and Lixian Town in the Daxing District of Beijing
and the Guangyang District of Langfang in the Province of Hebei. With a 46km/28.5-mile distance from
Tiananmen Square, a 67km/41.6-mile distance from Beijing International Airport, and a 26km/16.1-mile

## **The City of Beijing**

Beijing is a city full of history and architectural miracles. The Forbidden City, the Great Wall,
and the Temple of Heaven are clear evidence of the city’s past and its rich cultural background.
However, in addition to its landmarks and historical sites, Beijing is a modern metropolis with
numerous amenities, innovative skyscrapers, and a dynamic urban lifestyle. In that way, it attracts
all types of travelers, equally meeting the needs of history buffs and contemporary urban visitors.
On the other hand, foodies can’t help but fall for Beijing’s culinary delicacies. Spicy and colorful
dishes such as the famous Peking duck, dumplings, and Beijing noodles guarantee mouthwatering
experiences. Last but not least, Beijing isn’t all about food and history. Trendy bars and
nightclubs, theaters, and a thriving music scene are also an integral part of the city’s charm.
Hence, it becomes evident that there are so many [things to do in Beijing][48] that he city leaves
all visitors simply enchanted.

## **FAQs**

### How big is Daxing Airport?

The gigantic Daxing Airport, with the impressive shape that has given it the nickname “Starfish”,
has enormous dimensions. There are currently 4 runways (with the prospect of becoming 7 in the
future) and a vast terminal building covering a 700.000m² area while the ground transportation
center extends to 80.000m².

### How much did Daxing Airport cost?

The construction of the mega-airport, which is expected to eventually become the busiest airport in
the world, cost an unsurprisingly large amount. The Chinese government is estimated to have paid
approximately **US $17.47 billion** for this colossal project.

### Is Beijing Daxing Airport the biggest in the world?

A lot of discussions have been going on about which airport is expected to be the biggest in the
world. Beijing Daxing Airport and Istanbul’s new airport (the two most recent and biggest airport
projects) “claim” this title. Beijing Daxing Airport has, in fact, the biggest, single terminal
building while [Istanbul International Airport][49], in its final phase, is expected to be the
biggest airport globally in terms of passenger traffic.

### Who designed Daxing Airport?

[Daxing airport’s terminal][50] building is the impressive outcome of the collaboration between ADP
Ingeniérie (ADPI) and the architecture team of Zaha Hadid (ZHA) who tragically passed away in 2016.
Subsequently, in August 2018, Hong Kong design studio Lead 8 undertook the design of the new
commercial terminal which is anticipated to respond to every passenger’s needs.

### What about the Daxing airport master plan?

The Daxing airport master plan was assigned to NACO (Netherlands Airport Consultants) and was
developed with high respect for environmental protection. Since there are less than 600m between
checkpoints and gates and a minimum waiting time for baggage claim, this airport was built on the
basis of simplifying passenger procedures. Furthermore, NACO paid great attention to the ground
transportation system of the airport. High-speed and intercity trains, metro and public buses
connect the new airport to Beijing city and other major areas in a fast and efficient way.

### Which airlines fly to Beijing Daxing?

All the major airlines (domestic and international) are present at Beijing Daxing Airport. In
detail, PKX Airport is the hub for Air China, Bejing Capital Airlines, China Eastern Airlines, China
Southern Airlines, China United Airlines, and Xiamen Air. Moreover, it is a focus city for Hebei
Airlines. Overall, the airlines that are members of Skyteam Alliance, as well as some of the
Oneworld airlines, fly to Beijing Daxing International Airport, while most Star Alliance airlines
still use Beijing Capital Airport.

### How many runways does Daxing Airport have?

For the time being, Daxing Airport has four runways and 79 airport stands. The 4 runways’ size is
impressive while the airport stands are suitable both for one twin-aisle and two single-aisle
planes. Eventually, the airport will have 7 runways in total and will be able to serve about 620.000
flights annually.

### What are the transportation options from Daxing Airport?

[Daxing airport transportation][51] system is effective and affordable. The new [Beijing-Xiong’an
Intercity railway][52] connects [Daxing Airport to the Beijing city center,][53] while a second
train line runs from PKX Airport to Tianjin. On the other hand, [Daxing Airport Express][54] (the
Daxing airport subway line) provides connections to Beijing in only 22 minutes, and [buses][55] also
link the airport to various parts of Beijing and intercity destinations. Moreover, [Daxing airport
taxis][56] are reliable and comfortable, while [private airport transfers][57] guarantee lavish
services. Finally, [rental cars][58] are also available at Beijing Daxing Airport.

facilities][37]. Thus, the Car Parks P1 and P2 are designated for short-term parking, while
travelers who wish to park their vehicles for a long period of time (more than 8 hours) can use the
long-stay P3 Parking Lot. Designated areas for passengers with disabilities and families are to be
found in all parking premises. Additionally, other services and amenities (electric vehicles’
charging stations, AGV automatic parking robots, tire inflation, etc.) are also provided.

## **Transit Options**

Beijing Daxing Airport is efficiently connected to the city of Beijing, located around 46km/28.5
miles from the capital of China. Hence, travelers wishing to get from [PKX Airport to Beijing][38]
can choose among the following options:
* [airport taxis][39]
* [airport car rentals][40]
* [private airport transfers][41]
* [buses][42] and coaches
* [train lines][43]
* [subway][44] journeys

## **Services and Amenities**

PKX Airport offers a wide variety of services and amenities to cater to the needs of every
passenger. To name a few, you can take a look at some of the most sought-after services:

 
* Cafes, restaurants, and bars
* Countless shops
* Duty-free areas
* Baggage carts / Luggage wrapping / Luggage Storage
* Meet & Greet services
* Pharmacies /Medical services (5 first aid rooms and 1 first aid station)
* Postal Office
* Banks / ATMs / Currency exchange areas
* Baby care rooms
* Play areas
* Lost & Found offices
* Smoking areas
* Lounges
* Spa facilities
* Cultural exhibitions
* [Transit hotels][45]
* Wi-Fi
* Charging stations
* Information kiosks
* Special services and amenities for passengers with disabilities

## **The City of Beijing**

Beijing is a city full of history and architectural miracles. The Forbidden City, the Great Wall,
and the Temple of Heaven are clear evidence of the city’s past and its rich cultural background.
However, in addition to its landmarks and historical sites, Beijing is a modern metropolis with
numerous amenities, innovative skyscrapers, and a dynamic urban lifestyle. In that way, it attracts
all types of travelers, equally meeting the needs of history buffs and contemporary urban visitors.
On the other hand, foodies can’t help but fall for Beijing’s culinary delicacies. Spicy and colorful
dishes such as the famous Peking duck, dumplings, and Beijing noodles guarantee mouthwatering
experiences. Last but not least, Beijing isn’t all about food and history. Trendy bars and
nightclubs, theaters, and a thriving music scene are also an integral part of the city’s charm.
Hence, it becomes evident that there are so many [things to do in Beijing][48] that he city leaves
all visitors simply enchanted.

## **FAQs**

### How big is Daxing Airport?

The gigantic Daxing Airport, with the impressive shape that has given it the nickname “Starfish”,
has enormous dimensions. There are currently 4 runways (with the prospect of becoming 7 in the
future) and a vast terminal building covering a 700.000m² area while the ground transportation
center extends to 80.000m².

### How much did Daxing Airport cost?

The construction of the mega-airport, which is expected to eventually become the busiest airport in
the world, cost an unsurprisingly large amount. The Chinese government is estimated to have paid
approximately **US $17.47 billion** for this colossal project.

### Is Beijing Daxing Airport the biggest in the world?

A lot of discussions have been going on about which airport is expected to be the biggest in the
world. Beijing Daxing Airport and Istanbul’s new airport (the two most recent and biggest airport
projects) “claim” this title. Beijing Daxing Airport has, in fact, the biggest, single terminal
building while [Istanbul International Airport][49], in its final phase, is expected to be the
biggest airport globally in terms of passenger traffic.

### Who designed Daxing Airport?

[Daxing airport’s terminal][50] building is the impressive outcome of the collaboration between ADP
Ingeniérie (ADPI) and the architecture team of Zaha Hadid (ZHA) who tragically passed away in 2016.
Subsequently, in August 2018, Hong Kong design studio Lead 8 undertook the design of the new
commercial terminal which is anticipated to respond to every passenger’s needs.

### What about the Daxing airport master plan?

The Daxing airport master plan was assigned to NACO (Netherlands Airport Consultants) and was
developed with high respect for environmental protection. Since there are less than 600m between
checkpoints and gates and a minimum waiting time for baggage claim, this airport was built on the
basis of simplifying passenger procedures. Furthermore, NACO paid great attention to the ground
transportation system of the airport. High-speed and intercity trains, metro and public buses
connect the new airport to Beijing city and other major areas in a fast and efficient way.

### Which airlines fly to Beijing Daxing?

All the major airlines (domestic and international) are present at Beijing Daxing Airport. In
detail, PKX Airport is the hub for Air China, Bejing Capital Airlines, China Eastern Airlines, China
Southern Airlines, China United Airlines, and Xiamen Air. Moreover, it is a focus city for Hebei
Airlines. Overall, the airlines that are members of Skyteam Alliance, as well as some of the
Oneworld airlines, fly to Beijing Daxing International Airport, while most Star Alliance airlines
still use Beijing Capital Airport.

### How many runways does Daxing Airport have?

For the time being, Daxing Airport has four runways and 79 airport stands. The 4 runways’ size is
impressive while the airport stands are suitable both for one twin-aisle and two single-aisle
planes. Eventually, the airport will have 7 runways in total and will be able to serve about 620.000
flights annually.

### What are the transportation options from Daxing Airport?

[Daxing airport transportation][51] system is effective and affordable. The new [Beijing-Xiong’an
Intercity railway][52] connects [Daxing Airport to the Beijing city center,][53] while a second
train line runs from PKX Airport to Tianjin. On the other hand, [Daxing Airport Express][54] (the
Daxing airport subway line) provides connections to Beijing in only 22 minutes, and [buses][55] also
link the airport to various parts of Beijing and intercity destinations. Moreover, [Daxing airport
taxis][56] are reliable and comfortable, while [private airport transfers][57] guarantee lavish
services. Finally, [rental cars][58] are also available at Beijing Daxing Airport.

sebanyak mana ia menyelesaikannya.

## Kuasa Udara Indo-Pasifik ][81]

[Berita][82]
India berjaya menguji peluru berpandu permukaan-ke-udara jarak jauh Kusha buatan tempatan, sistem
berjulat 400km yang direka beroperasi bersama S-400 Triumf bagi merapatkan jurang teknologi dengan
kuasa pertahanan udara global. Menteri Pertahanan Rajnath Singh menggelarnya pencapaian yang hanya
mampu dicapai segelintir negara — dan ia secara langsung mengubah pengiraan pencegahan terhadap
Pakistan dan China.

## [ Singapura Lancar Kapal Perang “Mothership” Halimunan RSS Valour, RSN Percepat Perlumbaan
## Senjata Laut Serantau Di Selat Melaka… ][83]

[Berita][84]

yang direka mengawal armada drone udara, permukaan dan bawah air — satu isyarat strategik ketika
ketegangan tentera laut serantau semakin meningkat.

## [ Kapal Selam Nuklear Misteri China Muncul di Limbungan Jiangnan — Reka Bentuk “Tanpa Menara
## Kawalan” Ini Boleh Ubah Imbangan… ][85]

[Berita][86]
Sebuah kapal selam serangan nuklear China yang baharu dikesan di Limbungan Jiangnan, Shanghai,
memiliki menara kawalan yang amat minimum — satu perubahan reka bentuk berfokus siluman yang
memperluas keupayaan peperangan bawah laut China dan mencetuskan persoalan baharu buat perancang
tentera laut AS serta sekutu di Indo-Pasifik.

## [ Rusia Didakwa Bekal Teknologi Dron Rahsia Kepada Iran: Siasatan AS Dedah Serangan Tepat Ke Atas
## Stesen CIA Riyadh ][87]

[Berita][88]
Agensi perisikan Amerika Syarikat sedang menyiasat sama ada Rusia membekalkan Iran dengan teknologi
dron teruji pertempuran dan data risikan penyasaran yang digunakan dalam serangan tepat ke atas
stesen CIA di Riyadh dan timur Iraq — satu eskalasi disyaki yang membawa implikasi global terhadap
keselamatan infrastruktur perisikan, pertahanan udara Teluk, dan ketegangan strategik AS-Rusia-Iran
pada 2026.

## [ [VIDEO] Türkiye Tamatkan Pergantungan Berdekad Terhadap Torpedo DM2A4 Jerman Dan Mk 48 Amerika

### R&D Decision Makers

millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

We help Business Development teams identify startups and new entrants with disruptive technologies,
and track the activities of industry leaders, academic research institutions, and domain experts.
Equipped with these insights, BD teams can make informed decisions about which companies to
collaborate with.
Why Discovery?

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA is a newly established Four Star Hotel located in Addis Abeba the capital and
diplomatic seat of Ethiopia.

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA offers high-end facilities with premium services to our guests. With our
different outlets, our guests can have a unique experience and pleasure throughout their stay with
us.

## What makes ELGEL unique?

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA is the premier hotel for this rare and beautiful natural wonder, where you can
have out of city experience at within Addis.

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA has an Indoor Swimming Pool, Bar & BBQ area, Restaurant, Cultural Restaurant, a
24-hour Front Desk, Room Service, Laundry, Pastry & Bakery, Gym, Sauna, and Steam along with free
Wi-Fi throughout the property. Our own ELGEL’s VIEW Grill-strategically located towards the green
forest view and eye-catching landscape is a must to see and feel the experience– also we have a
playground for the little ones.

There is a free private parking and the property provides free shuttle service from and to the
airport.

The rooms comes with, electronic card sensor switch, a flat-screen with IP TV channels, an electric
teapot/kettle, box shower, a hairdryer and writing table and chair. Some of the rooms have Garden
view, and others have city view.

*All these elements make ELGEL a unique Hotel establishment in Addis!*

## What makes ELGEL unique?

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA is the premier hotel for this rare and beautiful natural wonder, where you can
have out of city experience at within Addis.

ELGEL HOTEL AND SPA has an Indoor Swimming Pool, Bar & BBQ area, Restaurant, Cultural Restaurant, a
24-hour Front Desk, Room Service, Laundry, Pastry & Bakery, Gym, Sauna, and Steam along with free
Wi-Fi throughout the property. Our own ELGEL’s VIEW Grill-strategically located towards the green
forest view and eye-catching landscape is a must to see and feel the experience– also we have a
playground for the little ones.

There is a free private parking and the property provides free shuttle service from and to the
airport.

The rooms comes with, electronic card sensor switch, a flat-screen with IP TV channels, an electric
teapot/kettle, box shower, a hairdryer and writing table and chair. Some of the rooms have Garden
view, and others have city view.

*All these elements make ELGEL a unique Hotel establishment in Addis!*

## Natural Healing Resources

Ensana is Europe’s largest operator of health spas. We are proud that all eight Ensana destinations
are located in places of exceptionally rich natural resources with a long history of medical
expertise that continues to grow in line with our ongoing scientific research.

[
Explore resources
][89]
Thermal Water
Mineral Water
Salt Water
Healing Mud
Natural CO₂
[hands in the water stream]

### Thermal Water

The precious source of health and relaxation. Thermal mineral water is characterised by its
naturally warm temperature and rich mineral composition.

[Explore][90]
1/5
[Spa cup standing with the background of the spa complex]

### Mineral Water

An efficient natural remedy with stress-reducing effects. Waters contain high levels of minerals (an
average of 15mg per litre), plus gases and micro elements that are dissolved in the water as it
passes through underground rock.

[Explore][91]
2/5
[Pieces of ice floating on the surface of the water]

### Salt Water

Healing effects for skin diseases, mobility disorders and gynaecological conditions. Salt water and
anti-bacterial healing mud at our Ensana hotels in Sovata come from an unusual geological
phenomenon: the only natural helio-thermal lake in Europe.

[Explore][92]
3/5
[Feet wrapped in healing mud]

### Healing Mud

Great remedy for musculoskeletal disorders and skin diseases. Like thermal and spring water, healing

# Connect** real-world behavior** to business outcomes

Foursquare is the industry-leading location intelligence platform, from turnkey measurement
solutions for marketers to scalable building blocks for developers and beyond.

[Speak to sales][107]

[Try for free][108]

### #1 in location intelligence

[Thumbnail]

### 500%+ with FSQ Attribution

[Thumbnail]

### Best innovation in mobile & device development for Places API

[Thumbnail]
[Mobile Background Image][Background Image]

### Get high-performing Q3 targeting ideas

From back-to-school and Labor Day to summer travel and NFL kickoff, explore a library of
customizable, location-based targeting strategies proven to drive real-world results.

[Get the Q3 guide][109]

## The trusted leader in location technology & data

Unlock revenue, marketing, and product strategies across business needs. Enrich data, power POI in
apps, boost usage, and conduct competitive analysis.

[See our products][110]

### **Quality at scale**

Stop-detection precisely maps visits to locations. Over 16B check-ins fuel a dynamic map of 100M+
POIs across 200+ countries, capturing 9B+ monthly visits from 500M+ devices worldwide

### **Privacy-forward**

Data privacy is important to us. Consumers have full control over their data, and our partners
undergo regular audits to help ensure privacy standards are upheld.

### **Expertise**

With 15+ years perfecting our best-in-class location technology, we are committed to scaling with
you as your needs evolve.

### Flexibility

With 550+ integrated partners, from AWS to the Trade Desk, our data is accessible and delivered via
your preferred sources and formats.

Leading brands use Foursquare

Outlook News

## FAQs about GPTZero

Everything you need to know about GPTZero and our ChatGPT detector.

Can’t find an answer? You can talk to our [customer service team.][61]

### What is GPTZero?

GPTZero is the first and leading AI detector that allows you to identify specific content in a
document or text that has been generated by a large language model (LLM), such as ChatGPT. Founded
in January 2023, GPTZero has served over 10 million users to date and works with 100+ organizations
in education, hiring, publishing, legal and more.

### How does AI detection work?

AI detectors work by looking for patterns in text that are more likely to have been written by a
machine than a human. The most common factors they look for include: Perplexity: Is the writing
obviously predictable? Burstiness: How much variation is there in the sentence length and style?
Style: Is the tone and writing style overly generic or repetitive? GPTZero uses its own proprietary
model that takes hundreds of factors into consideration and boasts the highest detection accuracy in
the industry

### Is GPTZero’s AI detector accurate?

Yes. Independent benchmarks, like our partners at Penn State's AI Research Lab, and our own
large-scale testing show that GPTZero is the most accurate AI detector, with a 99% accuracy rate
when spotting AI-generated text vs. human writing. This means we correctly classify AI writing 99
out of 100 times and keep misclassification of text to an absolute minimum. Our results were further
validated on [RAID][62], a comprehensive, third-party benchmark where GPTZero was shown to be the
most accurate AI detector in North America, detecting 95.7% of AI texts while only incorrectly
predicting 1% of human texts as AI, an accuracy that jumps to over 99% when filtering to modern LLMs
like GPT4. Unlike many competitors, GPTZero can reliably detect "mixed documents" (where human and
AI writing are combined) with a 96.5% accuracy rate. While no AI detector can ever truly be 100%
perfect, we are committed to being a leader in responsible adoption of AI generation and AI
detection technologies.

### How do I use GPTZero’s AI detection tool?

You can start using GPTZero straight away in 3 easy steps: Paste Text or Upload Document: Paste in
raw text or upload your file for review and press ‘Scan’. For scans over 10,000 characters, create a
free account first. See Your Results: GPTZero will suggest what percentage of your text is likely to
be AI-generated and highlight the specific phrases it has detected. Download our Chrome Extension
for Google Docs and web: View AI detection and typing pattern metrics on any page, allowing you to
spot AI-created content with ease.

### Who is GPTZero for?

GPTZero is the most trusted AI content checker in education, both for teachers and students who use
GPTZero to guide conversations on academic integrity and writing improvement. GPTZero is used in
over 3500 colleges and 100s of institutions. We also serve publishers, recruiters, copy-writers,
marketers and businesses where authentic and quality writing truly matters.

### Does the GPTZero AI Content Checker only detect ChatGPT outputs?

No. GPTZero works across a wide range of AI language models, including but not limited to ChatGPT,
GPT-5, GPT-4, GPT-3, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Deepseek, and AI services based on those models. Our
detector is designed for the highest accuracy rate regardless of which model may have produced the
text. In our latest model release, we’ve updated the majority of our training data, including more
AI documents from: OpenAI – GPT4.1,GPT4.1-mini, o3, o3-mini Gemini – 2.5 Pro, 2.5 Flash, 2.5
Flash-Lite Claude, Sonnet 4 as well as a few other models.

## FAQs about GPTZero

Everything you need to know about GPTZero and our ChatGPT detector.

Can’t find an answer? You can talk to our [customer service team.][61]

### What is GPTZero?

GPTZero is the first and leading AI detector that allows you to identify specific content in a
document or text that has been generated by a large language model (LLM), such as ChatGPT. Founded
in January 2023, GPTZero has served over 10 million users to date and works with 100+ organizations
in education, hiring, publishing, legal and more.

### How does AI detection work?

AI detectors work by looking for patterns in text that are more likely to have been written by a
machine than a human. The most common factors they look for include: Perplexity: Is the writing
obviously predictable? Burstiness: How much variation is there in the sentence length and style?
Style: Is the tone and writing style overly generic or repetitive? GPTZero uses its own proprietary
model that takes hundreds of factors into consideration and boasts the highest detection accuracy in
the industry

### Is GPTZero’s AI detector accurate?

Yes. Independent benchmarks, like our partners at Penn State's AI Research Lab, and our own
large-scale testing show that GPTZero is the most accurate AI detector, with a 99% accuracy rate
when spotting AI-generated text vs. human writing. This means we correctly classify AI writing 99
out of 100 times and keep misclassification of text to an absolute minimum. Our results were further
validated on [RAID][62], a comprehensive, third-party benchmark where GPTZero was shown to be the
most accurate AI detector in North America, detecting 95.7% of AI texts while only incorrectly
predicting 1% of human texts as AI, an accuracy that jumps to over 99% when filtering to modern LLMs
like GPT4. Unlike many competitors, GPTZero can reliably detect "mixed documents" (where human and
AI writing are combined) with a 96.5% accuracy rate. While no AI detector can ever truly be 100%
perfect, we are committed to being a leader in responsible adoption of AI generation and AI
detection technologies.

### How do I use GPTZero’s AI detection tool?

You can start using GPTZero straight away in 3 easy steps: Paste Text or Upload Document: Paste in
raw text or upload your file for review and press ‘Scan’. For scans over 10,000 characters, create a
free account first. See Your Results: GPTZero will suggest what percentage of your text is likely to
be AI-generated and highlight the specific phrases it has detected. Download our Chrome Extension
for Google Docs and web: View AI detection and typing pattern metrics on any page, allowing you to
spot AI-created content with ease.

### Who is GPTZero for?

GPTZero is the most trusted AI content checker in education, both for teachers and students who use
GPTZero to guide conversations on academic integrity and writing improvement. GPTZero is used in
over 3500 colleges and 100s of institutions. We also serve publishers, recruiters, copy-writers,
marketers and businesses where authentic and quality writing truly matters.

### Does the GPTZero AI Content Checker only detect ChatGPT outputs?

No. GPTZero works across a wide range of AI language models, including but not limited to ChatGPT,
GPT-5, GPT-4, GPT-3, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Deepseek, and AI services based on those models. Our
detector is designed for the highest accuracy rate regardless of which model may have produced the
text. In our latest model release, we’ve updated the majority of our training data, including more
AI documents from: OpenAI – GPT4.1,GPT4.1-mini, o3, o3-mini Gemini – 2.5 Pro, 2.5 Flash, 2.5
Flash-Lite Claude, Sonnet 4 as well as a few other models.

## A private residence, rich in history

[Clefs Michelin]
[Relais & Châteaux]

# Vivre Paris

Just steps from the Champs-Élysées, Hôtel Balzac is a discreet haven, a vibrant historical site
reborn after a complete renovation envisioned by Festen Architecture. It invites you to live a
chapter of your own story in an exclusive Parisian setting, elegant and forever romantic.

[[image]][5] [[image]][6] [[image]][7] [[image]][8] [[image]][9]


## Rooms & Suites Sheltered from the world

Sleek spaces, luxurious materials, and artistic lighting define our 58 rooms and suites, each a
haven inspired by the understated elegance of the 1930s. These cocoons offer a retreat where you can
rejuvenate while taking in the Parisian life. Some rooms boast views of the Eiffel Tower, and the
two top-floor suites feature sky-high terraces.

[hotel]


[hotel]


[hotel]


[hotel]


[Choose a room][10] [Choose a Suite][11]
[[image]][12] [[image]][13] [[image]][14]

## Sharing moments

Beneath its majestic glass roof, the lounge at Hotel Balzac welcomes Parisians and travelers from
around the world for a break during a day of shopping, a lunch with friends, or a discreet meeting.
Nestled in an alcove, the Hotel Balzac bar hosts night owls who write the story of Paris, from
rendezvous to reunions.

[Explore][15]
[image]

### Spa Ikoi

Designed to offer unique moments of escape with a holistic approach directly inspired by traditional
Japanese methods, the Ikoi Spa at Hotel Balzac provides a range of treatments and massages on tables
or tatami mats. The pool, sauna, and state-of-the-art fitness room complete the facilities of this
unparalleled spa.

[Book your spa moment][16]

### Paris moments News & offers

[hotel]

### Family offer

Enjoy a family stay just steps from the Champs-Élysées by reserving our connecting rooms: a Boudoir
Room connected to a Superior Room for up to 4 guests, or to a Junior Suite for up to 5 guests. Take
advantage of this exceptional offer, which includes a 30% discount on the Boudoir Room, along with
daily breakfasts included. Offer valid for stays of 3 nights or more, from April 14th to May 8th
2025, from July 15th to August 31st 2025, and from November 1st 2025, to March 31st 2026, excluding
holiday periods and Fashion Weeks. Subject to availability. The discount is already reflected in the
displayed rate.

[Book now][17]
[hotel]

### Hôtel Balzac X La Samaritaine

Enjoy an exclusive shopping experience! Treat yourself to an exceptional getaway and enjoy a special
escape at La Samaritaine, with a 3-hour private session with a personal stylist in the heart of the
Appartement de La Samaritaine.

[book the experience][18]
[hotel]

### Hotel Balzac by Festen

Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo Sauzay, the duo behind Festen Architecture, have transformed Hotel
Balzac into a unique destination, blending grand hotel spirit with intimate chic. Inspired by the
hotel's facade and architectural details, they created a distinctive atmosphere while honoring its
history and heritage. From the glass-roofed lounge to the rooms and spa, the spaces offer a cozy and
welcoming ambiance. Neutral tones, clean lines, and refined materials such as wood, velvet, and
natural stone create timeless elegance. Light, considered as a true element of decoration, enhances
the space throughout the day. Custom-made furniture, reminiscent of the 1930s and 40s, is
reinterpreted with creative modernity and a constant focus on comfort. Every detail of this
renovation echoes Balzac's Parisian identity. "Balzac perpetuates a timeless Parisian hotel heritage
with its classicism. It's a place full of atmosphere, with a history that we have respected and
extended. You need to experience this place to understand it," say Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo
Sauzay.

[Book Your Stay][19]

[Clefs Michelin]
[Relais & Châteaux]

# Vivre Paris

Just steps from the Champs-Élysées, Hôtel Balzac is a discreet haven, a vibrant historical site
reborn after a complete renovation envisioned by Festen Architecture. It invites you to live a
chapter of your own story in an exclusive Parisian setting, elegant and forever romantic.

[[image]][5] [[image]][6] [[image]][7] [[image]][8] [[image]][9]


## Rooms & Suites Sheltered from the world

Sleek spaces, luxurious materials, and artistic lighting define our 58 rooms and suites, each a
haven inspired by the understated elegance of the 1930s. These cocoons offer a retreat where you can
rejuvenate while taking in the Parisian life. Some rooms boast views of the Eiffel Tower, and the
two top-floor suites feature sky-high terraces.

[hotel]


[hotel]


[hotel]


[hotel]


[Choose a room][10] [Choose a Suite][11]
[[image]][12] [[image]][13] [[image]][14]

## Sharing moments

Beneath its majestic glass roof, the lounge at Hotel Balzac welcomes Parisians and travelers from
around the world for a break during a day of shopping, a lunch with friends, or a discreet meeting.
Nestled in an alcove, the Hotel Balzac bar hosts night owls who write the story of Paris, from
rendezvous to reunions.

[Explore][15]
[image]

### Spa Ikoi

Designed to offer unique moments of escape with a holistic approach directly inspired by traditional
Japanese methods, the Ikoi Spa at Hotel Balzac provides a range of treatments and massages on tables
or tatami mats. The pool, sauna, and state-of-the-art fitness room complete the facilities of this
unparalleled spa.

[Book your spa moment][16]

### Paris moments News & offers

[hotel]

### Family offer

Enjoy a family stay just steps from the Champs-Élysées by reserving our connecting rooms: a Boudoir
Room connected to a Superior Room for up to 4 guests, or to a Junior Suite for up to 5 guests. Take
advantage of this exceptional offer, which includes a 30% discount on the Boudoir Room, along with
daily breakfasts included. Offer valid for stays of 3 nights or more, from April 14th to May 8th
2025, from July 15th to August 31st 2025, and from November 1st 2025, to March 31st 2026, excluding
holiday periods and Fashion Weeks. Subject to availability. The discount is already reflected in the
displayed rate.

[Book now][17]
[hotel]

### Hôtel Balzac X La Samaritaine

Enjoy an exclusive shopping experience! Treat yourself to an exceptional getaway and enjoy a special
escape at La Samaritaine, with a 3-hour private session with a personal stylist in the heart of the
Appartement de La Samaritaine.

[book the experience][18]
[hotel]

### Hotel Balzac by Festen

Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo Sauzay, the duo behind Festen Architecture, have transformed Hotel
Balzac into a unique destination, blending grand hotel spirit with intimate chic. Inspired by the
hotel's facade and architectural details, they created a distinctive atmosphere while honoring its
history and heritage. From the glass-roofed lounge to the rooms and spa, the spaces offer a cozy and
welcoming ambiance. Neutral tones, clean lines, and refined materials such as wood, velvet, and
natural stone create timeless elegance. Light, considered as a true element of decoration, enhances
the space throughout the day. Custom-made furniture, reminiscent of the 1930s and 40s, is
reinterpreted with creative modernity and a constant focus on comfort. Every detail of this
renovation echoes Balzac's Parisian identity. "Balzac perpetuates a timeless Parisian hotel heritage
with its classicism. It's a place full of atmosphere, with a history that we have respected and
extended. You need to experience this place to understand it," say Charlotte de Tonnac and Hugo
Sauzay.

[Book Your Stay][19]

Morocco, Mexico.
][111]
BASIC
[

### TRAKTOR

TRAKTOR - under this brand we produce hoses and fittings intended for the agricultural market. Same
as POWERMASTER quality and specifications. Despite the low prices, we ensure compliance with all
standards (GOST and EN).
][112]
STANDART
[
[STANDARD]

### STANDARD

The VERSO brand has been known in Russia and European countries since 2007 and belongs to the
STANDARD class. The main feature of this brand's products is reliability, Italian quality, and
safety of use. The low PPM level in production is ensured by choosing the best manufacturers.
][113]

## The Hydravia company is

«Гидравия» — ведущий российский оператор по обслуживанию гидравлических трубопроводов, работающий на
рынке с 2004 года. Мы — федеральный игрок с географией поставок от западных границ до Дальнего
Востока, а также ключевой партнёр в Казахстане и Беларуси. Наша инфраструктура объединяет склады,
офисы и производства в Санкт-Петербурге, Москве, Челябинске, Краснодаре и Кемерово общей площадью
более 9 000 м². Мы постоянно расширяем ассортимент и мощности, чтобы оставаться надёжным звеном в
цепочке поставок. Наша команда — это молодые, инициативные профессионалы, нацеленные на результат.
Внутреннее обучение и система оценки помогают нам расти без ошибок. Качество подтверждено
сертификатом ISO 9001:2015. Мы строим работу так, чтобы предупреждать проблемы, а не исправлять их,
и с каждым годом становимся лучше для наших партнёров.

## Hydravia
* Quality technical support, training on VFD equipment, access to standards and regulations
* Exclusive representation of 5 manufacturers and trust of more than 35 suppliers

The VERSO brand has been known in Russia and European countries since 2007 and belongs to the

## The Hydravia company is

«Гидравия» — ведущий российский оператор по обслуживанию гидравлических трубопроводов, работающий на
рынке с 2004 года. Мы — федеральный игрок с географией поставок от западных границ до Дальнего
Востока, а также ключевой партнёр в Казахстане и Беларуси. Наша инфраструктура объединяет склады,
офисы и производства в Санкт-Петербурге, Москве, Челябинске, Краснодаре и Кемерово общей площадью
более 9 000 м². Мы постоянно расширяем ассортимент и мощности, чтобы оставаться надёжным звеном в
цепочке поставок. Наша команда — это молодые, инициативные профессионалы, нацеленные на результат.
Внутреннее обучение и система оценки помогают нам расти без ошибок. Качество подтверждено
сертификатом ISO 9001:2015. Мы строим работу так, чтобы предупреждать проблемы, а не исправлять их,
и с каждым годом становимся лучше для наших партнёров.

    The Whirlpool system consists of a water pump, water return, heater and jets. Stable flow,

    SPA water feature systems combine waterfalls with laminar jets to create stunning visual
    effects.
    
    The SPA audio-visual system includes Bluetooth speakers and one TV. Users can play music or
    radio wirelessly, while the TV plays the user's favorite content.

    functions, and control panel for users to operate the spa bathtub with one button.

    role, the suction and circulation pump for water circulation, the heater is used for constant
    temperature, the ozone generator and UV lamps are used for sterilization and disinfection.
    
    SPA sterilization system includes ozone generator and UV lamp for sterilization.
    
    The SPA thermostat system consists of a heater that heats the water and maintains the water
    temperature at a constant level.
    
    The SPA framing system includes skirt boards for the bottom and perimeter of the spa hot tub.
    
    The SPA LED light system utilizes LED pool lights, mini lights, luminous nozzles and skirt
    strips. The LED lights provide uniform illumination, the mini lights highlight design details,
    and the glowing nozzles and skirting strips add a luminous ambient effect.

**lifestyle changes** you make outside of our sessions. With our guidance, you’ll gain the tools and
understanding to create lasting health and vitality.

performance:
* [**Physical Therapy**][25]**:** Restore strength and mobility with targeted care.

##### Nos installations

[

#### Bains chauds

Laissez la chaleur imprégner votre corps, apaisant chaque tension tout en profitant d’une ambiance
sereine qui vous entoure. Ces bains offrent une évasion thermale qui éveille les sens et régénère
l’âme.

][47]
[

#### Bain tempéré avec chute

Laissez l’eau vous envelopper dans notre bassin tempéré, où le doux murmure de la chute d’eau crée
un environnement apaisant. Ce bassin offre un parfait **équilibre** entre fraîcheur et chaleur,
permettant à votre corps de se détendre pleinement.

][48]
[

#### Bain froid

Parfait pour compléter un cycle de thermothérapie, ce bain réveille les sens et purifie l’esprit.
L’eau fraîche permet une détente musculaire profonde, favorisant une récupération rapide et un
bien-être optimal.

][49]
[

#### Gazebo détente

Trouvez refuge dans un espace conçu pour vous offrir un moment d’évasion à l’abri des éléments.

][50]

#### Salle de sel himalayen

Un environnement apaisant et purifiant. Les murs de sel cristallin de notre salle de sel himalayen
libèrent des ions négatifs bénéfiques, favorisant la détente, améliorant la respiration et
revitalisant l’esprit.

][51]
[

#### Salle d’exfoliation

Notre salle d’exfoliation élimine les cellules mortes, encourage la régénération cutanée, et laisse
votre peau douce, éclatante et revitalisée. Une véritable métamorphose pour votre peau et un hommage
à votre bien-être.

][52]
[

#### Saunas

La chaleur sèche de nos saunas est idéale pour détendre les muscles, améliorer la circulation et
purifier le corps. Pour une détente brumeuse, nos saunas à vapeur hydratent la peau et apaisent les
voies respiratoires, offrant ainsi une alternative apaisante. Ce rituel de chaleur élimine le stress
et revitalise l’esprit.

][53]

# Experience perfect harmony in Ticino. Wellness and Relaxation Holidays in Switzerland at Kurhaus
# Cademario

The **Kurhaus Cademario** has been the perfect destination for those seeking wellness and relaxation
for more than a century . Located on a sunny hillside in Switzerland, it offers a unique and
rejuvenating atmosphere. Founded by Dr. Keller for its geomantic properties, it **still fosters
inner harmony and well-being** .

An **Adults Only (16+)** retreat, Kurhaus Cademario welcomes guests who wish to enjoy moments of
absolute peace, surrounded by an elegant and distraction-free environment.

At 850 meters above sea level, surrounded by nature, it offers breathtaking views of Lake Lugano and
the mountains of Malcantone
