San Antonio Village · Makati City · Korean Jjimjilbang · Open 24 Hours

# New Lasema*Manila's Gateway to the Korean Bath*

Five herbal soaking pools, kiln saunas, an ice room, sleeping caves, body scrubs, and 12 hours of
unhurried time — the Philippines' original jjimjilbang, inside a full Korean wellness complex in
Makati

Rating **4.5 / 5** Sauna Entry **from ₱450** Hours **Open 24 / 7** Stay **Up to 12 Hours**
Chapter One

## The K-Drama You Can Step Into

Sampaloc Street · San Antonio Village · Makati City

Long before K-pop became a global currency and K-dramas turned the jjimjilbang into one of the
most-searched travel experiences on the internet, New Lasema Spa was already doing the real thing in
the heart of Makati. Opened on Sampaloc Street at the corner of Estrella — inside a corner building
that doubles as a Korean convenience store, restaurant, and salon — Lasema brought to the
Philippines something that had no local equivalent: an authentic, full-service Korean bathhouse
where you check in for the morning and leave, hours later, feeling genuinely different in your skin.

The jjimjilbang tradition in Korea is less spa and more civic institution — a place of democratic
relaxation where office workers, grandparents, and students share steam, hot pools, and borrowed
time in equal measure. Lasema imports that spirit faithfully. You check in, receive your key and
your uniform (the signature loose-fitting jjimjilbang outfit), and begin to move through a series of
thermal experiences that have no real Western parallel: five herbal pools each scented differently,
a salt sauna, a clay kiln, a charcoal room, an ice room, and, at the top of the building, sleeping
caves where guests genuinely nap for hours.

It is not a luxury spa in the Ayala Avenue sense. It is something more interesting: a place with
soul, regularity, and the particular warmth of an institution that knows exactly what it is and why
people keep coming back.

Address
8846 Sampaloc St, corner Estrella St
San Antonio Village, Makati
1203 Metro Manila

Chapter Four

## The Twelve-Hour Stay

Planning your visit · what to know · what to bring

The ideal Lasema visit is a long one. Regulars — and there are many, some who have been coming since
the spa first opened — recommend a sequence: hot pool first to open the pores, then the wet sauna,
then a dry kiln session, then the ice room for the jarring, clarifying contrast, then rest in the
sleeping caves, then a bowl of noodles with kimchi from the snack bar, then back for more. By the
time you finally shower, dress, and collect your locker key, four or five hours will have passed and
you will feel something that has no adequate translation in English but exists very precisely in
Korean: the sense of having been properly cleaned, inside and out.

The massage is an optional add-on that most guests agree is worth it. Reviewers consistently praise
the skill of the therapists, while noting that the tipping slip at the end — with its lowest
denomination of ₱100 — can feel more obligatory than its label suggests. Take that as context, not
deterrence. The body scrub, when available, produces the kind of result that turns first-timers into
converts.

Best times to visit: weekday mornings, before noon on Saturdays. The spa fills up in the late
afternoon as office hours end. For couples, ask about private massage rooms — the shared setup in
the standard area is fine for those comfortable with it, but privacy is available at a premium.

New Lasema occupies an unusual position in Manila's wellness landscape. It is the authentic thing in
a city that tends toward high-gloss hotel spas, and its authenticity is precisely what its regulars
defend most fiercely. The facilities are functional, the ambiance is deliberately unglamorous — the
"very homey, laid-back design," as one Tripadvisor reviewer called it — and the experience is
designed around ritual rather than aesthetics.

For first-timers who arrive with K-drama expectations (the pristine lighting, the spa-branded robes,
the staff who guide you through every step), Lasema asks for a small adjustment: you are here to
figure it out, the way Korean regulars do. The signage helps. The staff answer questions cheerfully.
But the etiquette belongs to you to research and observe. Those who enter with open expectations
leave evangelical. Those who arrive expecting a luxury hotel spa sometimes need a second visit to
understand what they were actually experiencing.

What to bring: shampoo, conditioner, body wash, facial wash, lotion in a small shower caddy. The
jjimjilbang uniform is provided. Bring cash — not all services accept cards. Try the shikye (Korean
rice beverage) and the boiled eggs from the snack bar: both have earned their cult status among
regulars.

New Lasema occupies an unusual position in Manila's wellness landscape. It is the authentic thing in
a city that tends toward high-gloss hotel spas, and its authenticity is precisely what its regulars
defend most fiercely. The facilities are functional, the ambiance is deliberately unglamorous — the
"very homey, laid-back design," as one Tripadvisor reviewer called it — and the experience is
designed around ritual rather than aesthetics.

For first-timers who arrive with K-drama expectations (the pristine lighting, the spa-branded robes,
the staff who guide you through every step), Lasema asks for a small adjustment: you are here to
figure it out, the way Korean regulars do. The signage helps. The staff answer questions cheerfully.
But the etiquette belongs to you to research and observe. Those who enter with open expectations
leave evangelical. Those who arrive expecting a luxury hotel spa sometimes need a second visit to
understand what they were actually experiencing.

What to bring: shampoo, conditioner, body wash, facial wash, lotion in a small shower caddy. The
jjimjilbang uniform is provided. Bring cash — not all services accept cards. Try the shikye (Korean
rice beverage) and the boiled eggs from the snack bar: both have earned their cult status among
regulars.

[Loft Thai - Spa & Thai Massage]
Introducing the best practices, stories, and insights from the
world’s [top Thai Spa & Massage][29].
[ Contact ][30]
[Best Thai Massage Bangkok]

#### [Thai Massage][31]

Enjoy various health [benefits of a traditional Thai massage][32] which focuses on stretching,
pulling and rocking movements. It incorporates use of the therapist’s hands, knees, legs and feet to
apply deep muscle compression, joint mobilization and acupressure.

[More details ][33]
[Best Oil Massage Bangkok]

#### [Aroma Oil Massage][34]

We use [organic essential oils][35] from plants, leaves, and flowers to massage on pressure points
of the body. The heated warm oil helps soften and expand the muscle tissues and puts your body into
a state of deep relaxation at Loft Thai Spa & Massage.

[More details ][36]
[Best Facial Treatments Bangkok]

#### [Facial Treatment][37]

A facial soothing massage treatment will deeply cleanse your skin by and prepare you for pampering
ritual. Our therapist will gently massage your face to improve your lymphatic system and skin
lifting while using an organic blend of ingridients to increase elasticity and firmness.

[More details ][38]

[Loft Thai - Spa & Thai Massage]

### [Discover our Spa Treatments][45]

Choose from our wide range of speciality body massages, facial treatment and therapeutic packages,
provided with care by our qualified & award-winning therapists. Using our own [brand of
dermatologically tested products][46], in addition to well-known and trusted luxury brands such as
Eau de Spa, Biotherm, Aesop and Chanel, we strive to provide all of our guests with a moment of
peace and tranquillity.

##### [Unique Spa Experience][47]

Our facial & body treatments are inspired by [ancient Thai rituals][48] and bestow a healing and
pleasant effect. A journey of total relaxation is experienced combined with an exfoliating,
hydrating and refreshing action to restore suppleness & hydration to the skin.

##### [Organic Spa Products][49]

For facial skin care we use 100% organic blend of ingredients by Eau de Spa, Biotherm, Aesop and
Chanel. It is an effective combination to cleanse, balance, repair moisturize and awaken your skin.
Back to basics is the new concept for modern beauty.

[About Loft Thai Spa][50] [Massage by Khun Pie][51]

#### [Inspirational Spa & Art Gallery][52]

With the mix of Thai and Modern [Art Spa décor element][53], the new Loft Thai Boutique Spa &
Massage is designed to be a haven tranquillity, a caring and peaceful environment to nurture the
spirit of modern life. Influences of the east are reflected within the décor of uniqe Thai modern
art, traditional wood carvings and floral murals, all of which have been lovingly hand-selected to
adorn the [historical area][54].

[Learn More][55]

#### [A Timeless Classical Elegance Thai Spa in the heart of Bangkok][56]

Inside, the Spa facilities are first-class and extensive. Including [ traditional Thai Massage
treatment][57] room, Oil Massage room, Foot Massage rooms and VIP suite treatment room. We offer
full privacy in a private massage room part of this restorative heaven.


[Learn More][58]

## Discover our Spa packages


With Loft Thai Spa opening its doors, our Spa packages are set to redefine wellbeing and beauty in
today’s Bangkok. Enjoy our special opening offer on all massages and treatments and embark with us
on a journey to discover your best self.

### **Discover Mantra Forest Spa**

### ** A tranquil wellness retreat hidden in Phang Nga’s forest**

20,000 square meters of pure serenity: 10 herbal pools, 6 onsen pools, 2 saunas, and more…

[ Book your day pass ][10]

## **Our Facilities**

## SPA

Your entry ticket includes a complimentary towel and access to all areas until 8 PM, along with
lockers and showers.

## Sauna

Our two-room sauna offers a calming space to detox, improve circulation, and support overall
wellbeing

## MASSAGE

Two open-air salas designed for traditional Thai and oil massages, surrounded by forest

## Herbal Pools

Turmeric Pool, Green Tea Pool, Coffee Pool, Cucumber Pool, Ice Bath, and our signature Tom Yum Pool

## **MASSAGE TREATMENTS**

### Back & Shoulder Massage

### Thai Massage

### Foot Massage

### Oil Massage

### ALOE Vera Massage

[ EXPLORE MORE ][11]

## What we offer

Set across 12 rai (20,000 sq.m.), Mantra Forest Spa is Southern Thailand’s largest wellness retreat.
Each zone is crafted as part of a sensory journey – from herbal pools and immersive onsen to our
one-of-a-kind signature Tom Yum Pool.

Serene corners invite you to relax, explore, and capture memorable moments, while nature’s embrace
offers both profound therapeutic benefits and a peaceful escape.

[ Read more ][12]

##### A great place to diversify your beach holiday. I really liked the variety of baths: I
##### especially remember the aromatic lavender, the unusual tom yum bath with lemongrass and the
##### relaxing mud baths. The sauna is at the perfect temperature, the pool is clean, there are
##### showers of different configurations and even a hydromassage waterfall for additional
##### relaxation.

## LIZA MEDVEDEVA

##### IMPECCABLY DESIGNED AND DEEPLY RESTORATIVE — EVERY DETAIL, FROM THE HERB-INFUSED POOLS TO THE
##### EXPERT TOUCH OF THE THERAPISTS, REFLECTS REFINED WELLNESS AT ITS BEST.

## JAMES

## FAQ

[ What is included with the entry ticket? ][13]

Entrance fee includes full-day access and complimentary towel rental

[ Where are you located and how can we get there? ][14]

We’re located in Phang Nga, just outside Phuket, only 5 minutes from the world-famous Samet Nangshe
Viewpoint.

Simply search ‘Mantra Forest Spa’ on Google Maps and you’ll find us.

[ Do children enter for free? ][15]

Children aged 4–12 years are priced at 990 THB per child

[ What types of massage do you offer? ][16]

At Mantra, we offer two open-air salas nestled in the forest, designed for traditional Thai and oil
massages. We recommend booking in advance as availability is on a first-come, first-served basis. To
reserve your massage, please contact us via WhatsApp or Line

[ What time do you close? ][17]

We’re open daily, all year round, from 9 AM to 8 PM

[ How can i book my ticket? ][18]

To get instant access to your day pass please book now through Megatix, our official online
ticketing provider. You can find the link at ‘contact us’ page or ‘book your day pass’.

# Benefits of the Bathhouse & Contrast Therapy

### Improved Circulation

Alternating between hot and cold treatments enhances blood flow, supporting overall health.

### Muscle Recovery

Contrast Therapy can reduce muscle soreness, inflammation, and support quicker recovery.

### Stress Reduction

The exposure to varying temperatures stimulates endorphin release, offering stress relief and mental
clarity.

### Mental Resilience

The therapy's ability to enhance alertness and cognitive function empowers mental resilience and
overall well-being.

from elite athletes to families who want more out of at-home wellness. Designed with input from the
23-time gold medalist and engineered by MasterSpas®, it seamlessly blends fierce performance,
low-impact fitness, and restorative hydrotherapy in one premium swim spa.

MasterSpas brings together fitness, recovery, relaxation, and family connection in one premium
backyard experience. One spa. Two experiences. Always a good time.

## About US

## Crafting Unforgettable Memories by the Red Sea

حيث تشرق الشمس دائمًا، يمكنك أن تشعر بأشعة الشمس على الأغطية والخوذات.
منتجع سبا مورينو لم يتذكر تدوم مدى الحياة.

يوفر منتجع مورينو مكتب الاستقبال يعمل على مدار 24 ساعة،99 متعددي اللغات، تسجيل دخول/خروج سريعة،
وحامل أمتعة، الإمساك ليموزين، غسل الملابس بصف السيارات، لا تنوع من الأطباق إلى خاص، خاص للعين، وملعب
متعدد الاستخدامات، وكرة شاطئية، وأنشطة رياضية يومية، وترفيه حي، وصالون تجميل/حلاقة،
ومتاجر واي فاي/تذكارات، براه فاي فاي مجانية، وطبيب حر على مدار 24 ساعة.

### Seaside Sophistication

Moreno Hotel invites you to experience seaside sophistication on the Red Sea in Hurghada.

### Crafting Red Sea Memories

Moreno Hotel weaves magic on the Red Sea in Hurghada.

## Services

## Services We Offer

### [Comfy Rooms][10]

Discover serene retreats and stylish accommodations, ensuring a comfortable stay with every visit.

### [Restaurant & Bars][11]

Indulge in culinary delights and crafted beverages amidst a welcoming ambiance in our dining spaces.

### [Swimming Pools & Beach][12]

Dive into relaxation in our pristine pools, offering a refreshing oasis under the sun.

### [Animation & Activities][13]

Experience vibrant entertainment and engaging activities that add an animated touch to your stay.

### [Aqua Park & Sports][14]

Stay active and entertained with a variety of recreational pursuits and sports options.

### [SPA & Diving][15]

Immerse yourself in wellness at our spa and explore the wonders of diving in the Red Sea.

## Why Choose Us

## Moreno Spa & Resort: Where Every Detail Is Designed for Your Comfort.

Where the sun always shines, you can feel the sun on your face and the sand between your toes Moreno
Spa & resort make memories that last a lifetime.

— moments filled with sunshine, serenity, and unparalleled comfort. Whether it’s the soothing touch
of the spa, the refreshing poolside ambiance, or the golden sunsets over the Red Sea, each
experience is meticulously crafted for your lasting joy.”

## Who We Are

**Guangdong Kasdaly Pool Spa Equipment Co., Ltd.**, founded in 1999, is a professional manufacturer
specializing in high-quality **swimming pool equipment, outdoor spa hot tubs, swim spas, and sauna &
steam products. **Our core product range includes wall-mounted and inground filters, sand filters
and pumps, underwater lights, waterfalls and water descents, stainless steel pool accessories, salt
chlorinators, SPA massage products, outdoor hot tubs, and steam rooms.

# Signature Spa
# A Luxury Spa Experience
# in Ludhiana

Escape the stress of daily life and indulge in soothing massage therapies at Signature Spa,
Ludhiana. Our expert therapists provide relaxing spa treatments, body massages, and wellness
therapies in a calm and hygienic environment.

[Book A Session][13]
[image]

## Immerse Yourself at Our World Class Spa Retreat

At Signature Spa Ludhiana, we combine professional massage techniques with a peaceful environment to
deliver the ultimate spa and wellness experience for your body and mind.

[ Learn More ][14]
[about]

### 25+

Years in the field offering spa services

### 1000+

Clients Served

### 99%

Satisfactory Rate of Our Customers

## Rejuvenating Spa Treatments Tailored for Ultimate Relaxation

###### Oil Cream Massage

Relax your body with our soothing oil cream massage designed to release muscle tension, improve
blood circulation, and provide deep relaxation.

###### Turkish Massage

Enjoy a traditional Turkish massage that combines stretching, deep pressure techniques, and
relaxation therapy to relieve stress and body stiffness.

[image 1]

###### Jacuzzi Therapy Massage

Experience ultimate relaxation with our jacuzzi therapy followed by a calming massage session that
helps detoxify the body and refresh the mind.

###### Luxury Spa Experience

ndulge in a premium spa experience with **5 luxurious therapies** including body massage, steam,
jacuzzi, and relaxation treatments for complete rejuvenation.

### Reserve Your Pampering Session Instantly!

Book your relaxing spa and massage session at Signature Spa Ludhiana today and experience stress
relief, body rejuvenation, and premium wellness therapies in a calm and luxurious environment.

[Book Now][15]

## What Our Happy Clients Say

Hear real experiences from guests who enjoyed soothing massages, luxury spa treatments, and complete
relaxation at Signature Spa.

“My experience with the Signature was amazing. They gave me the best massage the Best Buy in
Ludhiana anu di Best Buy in Ludhiana. I ever visit. Thanks for giving me the best massage. Now I’m
feeling very relaxed and calm. My pain feel very relaxed. Session was amazing. Thanks, Zoya”

###### Dheeraj Singla

“My experience with signature was amazing. They Give me the best massage ever now. I’m feeling very
good and calm, the best spa ever I visit in Ludhiana, thanks. Mahip g’’

###### Shivam Jhamb

“Thanks, signature spa for giving me the notorious massage. I’m feeling very relaxed very calm. Your
staff was amazing. They are very cooperative and very cool. Thanks for everything. Thanks for making
my day. Mahip g’’

###### Krish Goyal

## Schedule Your Spa Session Today!

Book your spa session at Signature Spa Ludhiana today and experience soothing massage therapies,
peaceful ambiance, and complete wellness designed to refresh your body and mind.

più solo un tema tecnico, ma una responsabilità organizzativa e strategica. Con il recepimento della

di gestione del rischio cyber basato su processi documentati, misure di sicurezza proporzionate e
una governance chiara, che coinvolge direttamente il management. Dalla gestione del rischio alla
sicurezza della supply chain, dalla notifica degli incidenti alla responsabilità dirigenziale, la

indicazioni dell’ACN. Adeguarsi non è solo una questione normativa, ma un passaggio necessario per

## WHistleblowing

Promuoviamo la Trasparenza e l’Etica nei Luoghi di Lavoro incoraggiando i nostri dipendenti,
collaboratori e stakeholder a segnalare la presenza di irregolarità.

In SITE, crediamo fermamente nei valori della trasparenza, dell’integrità e dell’etica negli affari.
Il nostro impegno per la creazione di un ambiente di lavoro sano e responsabile è evidente nella
nostra pratica aziendale quotidiana. Per sostenere questi principi abbiamo implementato un programma

# Testimonials

I felt like a princess at Soreti Spa…it is a beautiful spa where you receive royal treatment. The
staff was friendly and super attentive to my needs. They offered refreshments while I was waiting
for my service. I recommend the fresh fruit juice cocktail and tuna sandwich, YUMMY!. They carried
my belongs to the room to prep me for the best special Morrocan bath (body scrub and massage) I have
ever received. My skin felt renewed, like new born baby skin.
Asmeret Ghebremicael
Soreti is one of Addis Ababa’s top spa. dedicated to creating unique spa experiences for each guest.
You will instantly notice and feel warmth and charm the moment you walk into the spa. In addition to
soreti’s friendly and welcoming aura, it’s intuitive ability to understand, heal and ease your body,
mind and spirit will keep you coming back. I love their natural hair treatments and scalp massage,
traditional Morrocan ( Hammam bath), deep tissue massage among the many others rejuvenating services
they provide.
Mahlet berhe

the only spa that offers wide range services suited for its various clients. I appreciate the

### High quality hot tubs and accessories for holiday resorts holiday parks gyms fitness centres
### resorts spas

Leading the spas industry for more than 8 years

## Who We Supply

### Our UK distribution network provide spas and hot tubs for holiday parks, holiday resorts and
### holiday lodges, hotels, gyms, fitness centres and more.

### [Retailer / Resellers][29]

### [Hotels][30]

### [Wellness Centres][31]

### [Holiday Lodges][32]

### [Fitness Centres][33]

### [Rehabilitation Spas][34]

### Pioneers in Quality and Energy Efficiency

Play Video about riogrande image1 1.jpg

## Unique CMS System for Resellers

**The unique CMS system that is changing the hot tubs industry for suppliers.**

As a partner of Spa Care UK, you get free access to our innovative CMS system which allows you to
easily track all of your orders, finances, and schedule deliveries directly from your computer or
smartphone. This saves you a huge chunk of time and gives you an advantage over the competition,
freeing you up to spend more time on marketing, selling and doing what you do best.

## Awards

### We work closely with our trusted award winning partners to get our clients the best quality spas
### in the UK

The UK Pool & Spa Awards is a competition that is open to all companies involved in the delivery of
water leisure, regardless of trade association affiliation.

## Products

### The best distribution hub in the UK

### [Oasis Range][35]

### [Sunbeach Range][36]

### [Swim Spas][37]

## Reviews

### Let our customers rating talk for us

We had our hot tub delivered with super quick service and very professional. Nothing was too much
trouble. The installation was worth having and the team were very polite and friendly. Overall very
happy with the exceptional service and would thoroughly recommend this company.
[Haithem ferjani]
Haithem ferjani
Taj and James arrived when expected and positioned the tub with no problem at all. They were very
professional and nothing was too much trouble. Everything concerning the operating and care of the
tub was explained very clearly. Thank you for a job well done definitely 5 star service.
[Nadia Bridges]
Nadia Bridges
A company you can trust 100% that hold their customers satisfaction with high regard. Felt very at
ease from first time I spoke with Craig, who has all the time in the world for you. No questions too
big or small. Even delivered it himself when things weren't working out ! Really happy and are so
excited to use it tonight for the first time. Would highly recommend Craig and his team at SpaCare
UK (Scunthorpe Hot Tubs).
[Melissa Whinfrey]
Melissa Whinfrey
Just had my Eddard hot tub delivered today. It was a really awkward delivery, through tight gaps &
up several steps, but not a problem for Taj & James who delivered it & installed it. They filled it
for me, gave me loads of advice on maintaining the tub & had it up & running in no time.The guys
were brilliant & a good laugh as well. Couldn’t recommend them highly enough.
[Nick Barton]
Nick Barton
We had our Manhattan tub delivered late last night. Paul and his colleague were so helpful nothing
was too much trouble they worked in the dark by torchlight. The tub was set up with no worries or
concerns. I can’t recommend these guys anymore. Top lad top job thanks Paul.
[Lee Phillips]
Lee Phillips
if you are thinking about getting a hot tub these guys are the people to go to. Amazing service and
aftercare, the hot is absolutely amazing. They are brillaint from start to finish. thank you so
much, for all your help and amazing hot tub at an amaiy price and service.
[Leanne Taylor]
Leanne Taylor
I would like the Thank everyone involved making this purchase, The sales team and the delivery team,
They was amazing from start to finish for delivering a great service and a great item we was 50/50

Dan Plaskitt

have since used them and are also very pleased 👍

  The relaxing body massage in vadodara has been practiced for thousands of years. Almost all
  massages involve pressure, rubbing, or manipulation of the muscles and other parts of the body
  with your hands and fingers
* ### Hot Stone Massage
  
  Hot Stone Massage incorporates a customized massage with the use of hot stones to create a healing
  and relaxing experience. Each 45 | 60 | 90 Min minute massage eases muscle stiffness and increases
  circulation and metabolism.
* ### Full Body Massage
  
  full-body massage doesn't have to include your sensitive areas. ... A full-body massage usually
  includes your arms, legs, hands and feet, your neck and back, your stomach and buttocks.
* ### Shaistu Massage
  
  Shiatsu massage therapy relies on the use the fingers, thumbs and palm to apply pressure to
  various areas of the body’s surface to help heal common ailments and conditions, and correct
  imbalances in the body.
* ### Deep-Tissue Massage
  
  Deep tissue massage usually focuses on a specific problem, such as chronic muscle pain, injury
  rehabilitation.

service delivers professional, comprehensive and efficient solutions for clients worldwide. We are
specialists in what we do with access to all equipment manufacturers and leading brands related to

design consultancy services. Individually we are talented, experienced, passionate and driven.

or alongside privately owned properties providing bespoke spa design and operational concepts.

# The Best In Spas

For 37 years, United Spas Manufacturing has delivered spa excellence — from our family to yours.
Every spa and swim spa we design is built with your relaxation, comfort, and therapy in mind.
Experience the difference of a high-quality, USA-built spa. Your journey to unmatched comfort starts
here.

## Build Your Hot Tub or Swim Spa

Turn your dream spa into reality. Customize every detail and create the perfect hot tub or swim spa
for your lifestyle. Contact your local United Spas dealer today! 

[Get Started][18]
[Hot Tub Spa by United Spas Mfg]

## The United Spa Difference

At United Spas, we don’t just build hot tubs—we build confidence. Every spa is proudly American-made
and supported by our service team with over five years of hands-on experience per technician. From
delivery to long-term care, our experts are ready, reliable, and always within reach. We ensure your
spa arrives on time and in perfect condition, and our industry-leading warranty reflects the trust
we place in every product we build. United Spas is more than a brand—it’s your assurance that
support is always close and quality is never compromised.

## Powered by Connection, Built on Innovation

We believe relaxation should be intuitive, indulgent, and built for real life. That’s why every
United Spa is engineered with smart features that simplify maintenance and elevate your
experience—so you can focus on what matters: enjoying the moment. Powered by precision
craftsmanship, advanced technology, and a relentless drive to improve, we deliver performance you
can feel and reliability you can trust—every single time.

 

## You Design

United Spas has a variety of upgrades to make owning a spa a breeze! Our options are top of the line
with every intention to benefit our consumers and their spa. We don’t offer any options without
extensive testing and consumer feedback to insure that we are placing only the best at our customers
fingertips. 

[Options][19]
[Woman luxuriating in a hot tub spa]

## Quality & Excellence

At United Spas Manufacturing, quality isn’t just a promise — it’s our legacy. For over 37 years,
we’ve set the standard for excellence in the luxury hot tub industry.

How have we done it? By never compromising on quality. Every spa built to our specifications are
crafted with precision, using only the highest-grade materials and time-tested techniques.

From the solid, hand-built frames and expertly engineered plumbing systems to the flawless
electrical wiring and durable, multi-layer fiberglass shells, every detail is inspected, perfected,
and approved before a spa leaves our facility.

When you choose United Spas, you’re choosing a spa built with unmatched attention to detail,
reliability, and performance — because you deserve nothing less than the best.

[Tim Kelly, owner of United Spas Mfg, best hot tub spas in Modesto]

### A Family Business Spanning Two Generations

For over 37 years, United Spas Manufacturing, LLC has been more than a business — it’s been a family
tradition of quality, care, and innovation. Founded by Tim Senior and Nadine Kelly, what began as
their dream has grown into a trusted name that families across the West Coast turn to for
relaxation, comfort, and connection.

As the company has grown, one thing has never changed: our dedication to treating every customer
like family. After decades of hard work, Tim and Nadine have proudly passed the torch to their son,
Tim Kelly Jr., who carries forward the same values of integrity, service, and craftsmanship. At
United Spas, our family is honored to continue serving your family for generations to come.

[Read Our Story Here][20]
[Tim Kelly Jr., owner of United Spas Mfg]
[Hot tub and spas]

Whether you’re looking for soothing relaxation after a long day or powerful hydrotherapy for deep
muscle relief, these spas are built to exceed expectations. Engineered for both family enjoyment and
personal rejuvenation, our spas combine timeless craftsmanship with the modern features you deserve
— making it no surprise when friends and family ask, “Where did you get your spa?”

## BATHHOUSE

Bathhouses in Western Australia might be few for now, but the ones we do have are truly special.
From soothing mineral soaks to steamy saunas and calming rituals, each experience leaves you feeling
renewed. Even better, more bathhouses are on the horizon, making it easier than ever to soak away
the everyday and embrace pure relaxation. Looking for a bathhouse near me?
[ Bathhouses WA ][50]

## SAUNA

Contrast therapy is so HOT (and cold) right now. Community saunas are full of energy and are in some
of the best locations across Perth. And if you’re the quiet, sit in a sauna on your own type – the
private sauna scene is coming to a neighbourhood near you. Whatever your sweat style, the sauna
lifestyle is here to stay, and we’re all for it. Sweat it out at a sauna near me (and don't forget
to hydrate!)
[ Best Saunas WA ][51]

## STAYS

Western Australia has luxury accommodation in every corner of this beautiful state. Or maybe it’s a
simple retreat to nature you’re looking for. Finding the perfect base for a wellness weekend away
has never been easier. Whether you’re looking for accommodation with a sauna, hotels with a spa or
an outdoor bath, WA Wellness has all the must-stay wellness accommodation.
[ Wellness Stays WA ][52]

## RETREATS

The appeal of Wellness Retreats are at an all-time high, but how do you choose the right one? We’ve
done some research on the best wellness retreats in Western Australia and there is something for
everyone. Whether it’s a silent retreat, spa retreat, yoga or meditation retreat, day retreat or
longer...we know who's doing what where...so you can find the right wellness retreat in WA for you.
[ Wellness Retreats WA ][53]

## PRACTITIONERS

From health coaches and holistic healers to physiotherapists and medispa practitioners, Western
Australia is home to experts who care for your wellbeing inside and out. Think naturopathy,
acupuncture, energy work, skin therapies, and physio support that restores movement and balance.
Whether you’re seeking deep healing, glowing skin, or recovery for an active lifestyle, WA’s
practitioners are ready to help you feel your best.
[ Holistic Practitioners WA ][54]

## EXPERIENCES

Wellness in Western Australia is all about experiences that connect you to something bigger. Think
mindful hikes through breathtaking landscapes, meditation and movement in nature, or learning from
cultural experiences on Country. These experiences help you slow down, reset, and reconnect...with
yourself, with nature, and with the wisdom of the land you’re standing on. Ready for some nurturing
nature? WA has your nature prescription.
[ Wellness Experiences WA ][55]

## RETREAT VENUES

Retreat venues in Western Australia offer inspiring spaces to create unforgettable wellness, yoga,
and corporate retreats. From coastal sanctuaries to forest hideaways, WA has venues perfect for
meditation, movement, and group connection. Whether you’re searching for a private retreat or unique
nature-based locations, you’ll find the ideal setting to bring your vision to life, right here in
WA.
